d:
Bihar ke kishanganj sthit jile ke lain mohalla men burhi kali mandir ne apne 125 varsh pure kar lie. is mauke par hone par mandir ko bhavy tarike se sajaya gaya. vahin iske bad dhumdham se parampara ke mutabik dipavli ki madhy rat shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir ke bich pratima sthapit kar puja archana ki gaee.
